spells.description: Enchant the opposite-hand weapon with 35 bonus magic damage for 15 seconds. Cycling preserves the enchantment. Uses replenish at shrines.

Hold a blackflame tether for up to 2 seconds. First contact deals 120 fire damage and applies one lingering burn: 2% of maximum health over 0.75 seconds at 10 Arcane, rising with diminishing returns to 5% over 1.25 seconds at 60 Arcane. Higher Arcane grants no further benefit. Fire damage respects fire defence; the percentage burn bypasses defence but respects invulnerability. The burn finishes after release. Holding the link does not repeat the impact or burn. Uses replenish at shrines.

Launch a pale-edged blackflame shard toward your aim or locked enemy. Deals 120 fire damage on impact, then burns 2% of the target's maximum health over 0.75 seconds at 10 Arcane. Diminishing returns raise the burn to 5% over 1.25 seconds at 60 Arcane, with no benefit above 60. Fire damage respects fire defence; the percentage burn bypasses defence but respects invulnerability. The burn persists after impact. Repeated hits refresh the burn instead of stacking it. Uses replenish at shrines.
Place a field of embers. Activates after 0.3 seconds and burns enemies every half-second for 6 seconds. Uses replenish at shrines.
Launch a white-hot lance with an ember wake. Uses replenish at shrines.
Surge forward as a comet, striking crossed enemies once. Stops at walls and grants no invulnerability. Uses replenish at shrines.
Release an expanding flame ring around yourself. Uses replenish at shrines.
Call six stars onto a selected region. Ground seals mark the exact impact locations. Uses replenish at shrines.
Hold to pour flames into a forward fan for up to 2 seconds. One use per channel. Uses replenish at shrines.
A modest glint of condensed magic supplied by the equipped catalyst. Unlimited uses; consumes stamina during combat. Requires no spell memory. Stronger prepared spells remain separate.
Carry a healing sanctuary for 6 seconds, restoring 15 health every half-second to you and nearby allies. Uses replenish at shrines.
Restore 180 health after a committed healing cast. Uses replenish at shrines.
Send a broad lunar crescent through enemies, striking each once. Uses replenish at shrines.
Hold to channel a prismatic ray for up to 2 seconds. One use; damages the first target. Uses replenish at shrines.
Place a rune that arms after 0.6 seconds. An approaching enemy triggers an explosive magic burst. Uses replenish at shrines.
Hold a soul tether on a selected enemy for 2 seconds. Completing it deals a final burst; breaking range or sight severs it. Uses replenish at shrines.
A fast crystalline bolt. Each hit shatters into starlight. Uses replenish at shrines.
Strike a selected enemy with lightning that jumps to three more visible targets, losing 20% damage each jump. Uses replenish at shrines.
A modest holy spark supplied by the equipped catalyst. Unlimited uses; consumes stamina during combat. Requires no spell memory. Stronger prepared spells remain separate.
A radiant spear that pierces up to two targets. Uses replenish at shrines.
Summon a vulnerable mobile wisp for 12 seconds. It follows you and fires holy bolts at enemies. Uses replenish at shrines.
Arm four orbiting shards for 12 seconds. B or touch Command fires a homing volley without spending another use. Uses replenish at shrines.
